To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
HFD induces a sex-dependent remodeling of skeletal muscle, which is dependent on muscle IL6.
muscle IL-6 plays an important role on the adaptation to HFD in a sex-dependent way.
1) HFD treatment induced sex-dependent effects on skeletal muscle, 2) these effects were dependent on the presence of IL-6 in skeletal muscle.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of molecular and cellular mechanisms that regulate the effects of muscle IL-6 in skeletal muscle adaptation to a HFD in a sex-dependent way.
the identification of the role of muscle IL-6 in skeletal muscle in the presence of HFD.
the role of IL-6 in the regulation of skeletal muscle mass and fiber-type composition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
muscle IL-6 is required for the normal adaptation of skeletal muscle to HFD, especially in males.
HFD treatment is associated with increased body fat in both sexes and increased body weight in females.
muscular IL-6 deficiency prevents the HFD-associated increase of fast muscle fiber size in males and the fiber type switch in females.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
muscular IL-6 deletion in males prevents the HFD-induced increase of medium-large fibers, while in females it prevents the HFD-associated increase of fast-oxidation fibers.
muscle IL-6 plays a protective role against high-fat diet-induced metabolic changes in skeletal muscle in male mice.
muscle IL-6 is a key regulator of the muscle adaptation to HFD and this regulation is different in males and females.
The main takeaway from our work is that
muscle IL-6 is required for HFD-induced fiber type switching and muscle remodeling.
muscular IL-6 is a key player of muscle adaptation to HFD in both sexes but that the effects of muscular IL- 6 are differentially regulated in males and females.
muscle IL-6 is required to prevent the detrimental effects of HFD in males.
